description: Replace nvm with fnm: install.sh installs fnm and Node 24, and the smoke script, remote-sandbox checks, and documentation name fnm.

userStories.title: Install fnm and Node 24 from install.sh
userStories.description: As an operator on a host with no suitable Node, I want `install.sh` to install fnm and Node 24 so that `agro` runs without nvm.
acceptanceCriteria: Before the change, a new test in `.agro/scripts/__tests__/install.test.ts` for the fnm install fails.
On a host with no Node, `install.sh --yes` installs fnm into `$FNM_DIR` and runs `fnm install 24`, `fnm use 24`, and `fnm default 24`.
The installer sets the default of `FNM_DIR` to `$HOME/.local/share/fnm`.
The installer downloads the fnm installer from the tag in `AGRO_FNM_VERSION`. The default tag is `v1.39.0`.
`install.sh` does not create `~/.nvm`.
If `unzip` is missing, `apt-get` exists, and the user is root or `sudo -n true` exits 0, `install.sh --yes` installs `unzip` and continues.
If `unzip` is missing and `install.sh` cannot install `unzip`, `install.sh` exits non-zero and prints a message that names `unzip`.
`install.sh` adds one fnm setup block to each existing `~/.zshrc` and `~/.bashrc`. If neither file exists, `install.sh` adds the block to `~/.profile`. A second run adds no second block.
When `command -v node` resolves through a symlink to a file under `$FNM_DIR`, the `~/.local/share/agro/node` link points at the resolved file, not at the per-shell path.
`env -i HOME=<home> PATH=/usr/bin:/bin <home>/.local/bin/agro --version` exits 0 after a fnm install.
When `node` resolves under `${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}`, `install.sh` keeps the `agro` shebang pinned and does not install fnm.
`pnpm exec vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/install.test.ts` exits 0.
userStories.notes: Executed by advisor after commit inspection: pnpm exec vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/install.test.ts exit 0 (38 passed), bash -n install.sh exit 0. All acceptance criteria are covered by named tests with fake fnm, apt-get, sudo, and curl. Worker red run exit 1 (20 failed, 18 passed). Reasoned: an interactive no answer at the unzip prompt reaches the same die path. Real fnm install is deferred to US-003.

userStories.title: Replace the remaining nvm references
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the smoke script, the remote-sandbox checks, and the documentation to name fnm so that no path depends on nvm.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/scripts/cli-first-install-smoke.sh` loads fnm in its new-login check, and `--bootstrap-without-node` help text names fnm.
`.agro/scripts/__tests__/cli-first-install-smoke.test.ts` uses a fnm directory for its pinned case, and `pnpm exec vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/cli-first-install-smoke.test.ts` exits 0.
`agro-rows.sh`, `docker-egress.sh`, `hermes-home.sh`, and `openshell-journey.sh` under `.agro/skills/remote-sandbox/checks/` load fnm, and `bash -n` exits 0 for each file.
`.agro/skills/remote-sandbox/SKILL.md` and `.agro/skills/remote-sandbox/references/rationale.md` name fnm for current behavior.
`docs/installation.md` describes fnm, `AGRO_FNM_VERSION`, and the `unzip` behavior.
`CHANGELOG.md` has one entry under `## [Unreleased]` that links #1569.
A new or existing test in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/self-upgrade.test.ts` proves that `agro self-upgrade` keeps a `~/.local/share/agro/node` shebang.
`git grep -inE "\bnvm\b|NVM_" -- . ':!CHANGELOG.md' ':!.agro/tasks'` prints only the compatibility path of US-001, its tests, its documentation sentence, and history rows that name a past fix.
userStories.notes: Executed by advisor: under umask 022 (the default on CI), vitest for cli-first-install-smoke.test.ts and self-upgrade.test.ts exits 0. Under this shell umask 0077, 4 self-upgrade cases fail on a mode assertion, 448 vs 493, including two cases US-002 did not touch; src/commands/self-upgrade.ts is unchanged. bash -n exits 0 for the smoke script and four checks. ste-check docs/installation.md exits 0. nvm grep prints only the install.sh compatibility path, its tests, one docs sentence, and history row C9. Reasoned: the four checks did not run on a VM; their load lines match the smoke script.

userStories.title: Capture the fresh-install evidence
userStories.description: As the reviewer, I want a real install transcript so that I can confirm the change without a rerun.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/nvm-to-fnm/evidence/manual-review.md` holds a transcript from `docker run --rm debian:bookworm-slim` with `curl` and `ca-certificates` present and `node` and `unzip` absent at the start.
The transcript runs `bash .agro/scripts/cli-first-install-smoke.sh --phase bootstrap --bootstrap-without-node --bundle <bundle> --keep` from a new temp work directory, and the command exits 0.
The transcript shows a Node 24 version, `pinned_node=`, and the absence of `~/.nvm`.
The transcript shows `unzip -v` exit 0 after the install.
The story creates only the `--rm` container and the temp directory, and the story deletes the temp directory.
userStories.notes: Executed by advisor from the committed transcript: debian:bookworm-slim --rm container, node_before=ABSENT, unzip_before=ABSENT, smoke_exit=0, node_after version=v24.22.2, pinned_node to fnm node-versions path, nvm_dir=ABSENT, unzip_exit=0, agro_version_exit=0 under env -i, docker_run_exit=0. docker ps -a for the image lists no container. ste-check exits 0. Reasoned: the temp directory deletion is from the transcript cleanup section.
